en.connection.status.gateway-auth-required: This address is still protected by the old site login. Ask the administrator to configure a dedicated platform route. The admin platform password is not the old site password.
en.connection.status.platform-unavailable: This address does not provide the platform sign-in API. Ask the administrator to check the service version and platform route.
en.connection.signedOutUnconfirmed: Signed out on this device. Server-side session revocation has not been confirmed.
en.remote.sidebar.locationHint: Images and complete bilingual prompts are kept in the server library.
en.remote.sidebar.chooseHint: Connect to the server to browse, import and manage images and complete bilingual prompts.
en.remote.app.edited: Image changes saved to the server library
en.remote.app.created: Image added to the server library
en.remote.app.deleted: Image removed from the library; server recovery records are preserved
en.remote.app.browserPreview: Read-only browser preview · Server library. Use the Mac app to import, edit or delete.
en.remote.app.desktopRequired: Use the Mac desktop app to connect to the server and read images and full prompts.
en.remote.app.noLibrary: No server library is connected. Connect to the server to import images and prompt JSON.
en.remote.app.readonly: This server library is read only. You can browse and copy; managing images requires write access.
en.remote.gallery.chooseFolderHint: Connect to the server, then use Batch Import to choose one source folder containing images and a JSON file with full prompts.
en.remote.gallery.emptyHint: Use Batch Import to choose a source folder containing images and full-prompt JSON. Confirm to save to the server, or import images one at a time.
en.remote.editor.editHint: Changes are saved to the server library. Choose a local image file to replace the image.
en.remote.editor.importHint: Choose a local image, enter its complete English and Chinese prompts, then save it to the server library.
en.remote.editor.imageHint: Choose a PNG, JPEG, or WebP image (up to 30 MiB). Enter the prompts on the right. Saving uploads a copy; the original stays in place.
en.remote.delete.title: Remove from the server library?
en.remote.delete.description: This image will be removed from the server library. The server keeps the image, complete English and Chinese prompts, and a recovery record so it can be restored.
en.remote.batch.hint: Choose one source folder containing images and full-prompt JSON. Files are found automatically; preview the matches, then confirm to save to the server library. Images may be in subfolders. Source files are kept.
en.remote.batch.operation.preview: Uploading a preview and checking images and prompts…
en.remote.batch.reason.import: Matched successfully. Confirm to save a copy to the server.
en.remote.batch.reason.imported: The image and full prompts were saved to the server library.
en.remote.batch.confirmHint: Confirm to save {count} safe items to the server. Duplicate, conflicting, and invalid items are skipped. Source files are kept.
en.remote.batch.nothingImportable: No items can be safely imported. Review the issues, then choose new sources or edit the JSON. The server library has not changed.
en.remote.batch.reportSaved: Report saved in the server library: {path}
